seo.title: ODDference — where creative expertise meets business and society
seo.description: ODDference brings creative practitioners and business leaders into the same room. Blind Bird tickets for 2027 are open now, at €250.

title: Where creative expertise meets business and society.

concept.headline: What can business and the rest of society learn from creative expertise?
concept.body: ODDference brings creative professionals, business leaders, founders and decision-makers into the same room to explore what creative expertise can teach us about how we build organisations, businesses and society. It combines serious professional content, an unusual mix of people, and an experience shaped by artists and creative practitioners — not a conference that happens to feature creative speakers.

reasons.title: Ideas worth taking with you
reasons.body: ODDference brings together creative practitioners, founders, leaders, researchers and thinkers with perspectives that rarely appear in the same professional programme. You will learn something useful and see a familiar question differently.

reasons.title: People you would not normally meet
reasons.body: Creative professionals, business leaders, founders, policymakers, cultural leaders and researchers — deliberately in the same room. The mix is not a side benefit of ODDference. The people in the room are part of the programme.

reasons.title: A conference you actually experience
reasons.body: In 2027, creative expertise moves into the entire event, not just the stage — the experience can extend into things such as installations, performances, scenography, spaces, food and music. ODDference should demonstrate creative expertise, not only talk about it.

whoItsFor.label: Business leaders
whoItsFor.description: Making decisions with no ready-made playbook, and looking outside the usual business circuit.

whoItsFor.label: Organisational leaders
whoItsFor.description: Working on culture and change, where human behaviour matters as much as process.

whoItsFor.label: Entrepreneurs
whoItsFor.description: Building something that does not exist yet, and working with real uncertainty.

whoItsFor.label: Policymakers
whoItsFor.description: Shaping cities, funding and institutions — and wanting direct contact with the people affected.

whoItsFor.label: Creative leaders
whoItsFor.description: Bringing creative expertise into conversations about business and society, not just culture.

whatsChanging.headline: Less like a conference you attend. More like a place you enter.
whatsChanging.body: The professional programme stays the reason to come. What changes is everything around it: the strongest artistic and experiential work that used to live inside the centrally produced ODDfest now becomes part of ODDference itself, and the conference sits directly alongside the wider ODDfest creative week happening across Helsinki.

items.title: More immersive
items.body: The artistic and experiential layer — through things such as installations, performances, scenography and spatial design — becomes part of ODDference itself, not entertainment around it.

items.title: More connected
items.body: ODDference sits directly alongside the wider ODDfest creative week happening across Helsinki, instead of ending when the stage programme does.

items.title: More intentional encounters
items.body: More structure and space built in for people to actually meet, talk and discover people outside their existing networks.
